title: calea jamaicensis
intro: Calea jamaicensis, commonly known as Mexican Damiana, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and Jamaica. This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and treating mild cases of depression and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Calea jamaicensis include acting as a sedative, anxiolytic, and a mild stimulant, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids. The plant's bioactive constituents, including apigenin, luteolin, and isoorientin, are responsible for its therapeutic effects and potential health benefits.
